title: One glove becomes two for this crab
hook: When researchers removed one anemone, the crab split the remaining one
summary: In an experiment with one species of boxer crab, crabs split a remaining anemone after losing the other. The two pieces regenerated over several days.

text: This little crab carries a fluffy glove in each claw. Those gloves are actually living sea anemones.
Researchers removed one anemone from a species of boxer crab.

panels.text: What do you do with just one glove?

text: The crab gripped the remaining anemone and divided it in two. It didn't fetch a new one from elsewhere.
That sounds destructive, but the story continues. Over several days, each piece regenerated into an anemone.
The crab once again held one in each claw. The remaining glove had become a fresh pair.

panels.text: If only my socks could do that.
